## What does mod do?
With this mod, your parrots will remember the sounds they hear and replay them at random moments during gameplay, or whenever you ask them to.

## Features
Parrots can remember the last 64 sounds they heard in-game (except for music, jukeboxes, player sounds, and themselves). At a random moment, they will replay a sound, or they will do so when you click on them while you are sitting. All parrots have a 30-second cooldown, so you can't spam them.

## Some hotkeys
Hold Shift and press RMB with an empty hand while looking at a parrot to make it produce a unique sound.

## Why does this mod exist?
This mod was made for fun and occasional scary moments (since it can remember eerie mineshaft sounds too!). Have fun with it! You can also collect parrots with unique sounds (like the Ender Dragon's death and others). I honestly think parrots might become the cause of some wars on your servers!

## What versions does mod support?
* Minecraft 1.21
* Fabric Api 0.100.1+1.21 or higher 

## How can I help?
Right now, the mod supports only two languages: Russian (ru_ru) and English (en_us). You can help by adding other languages!

## Where can I find source-code or issue tracker?
All additional links you can find in side-box or right here:
* [Source Code](https://github.com/sanmardeveloper/educateyourparrots)
